mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI inflation remains below 2% despite the unemployment rate signal, indicating that wage pressures are not spilling over into consumer prices.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in industrial production growth below -5% y/y signals a supply shock that will drive up input costs and squeeze corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Equity market remains resilient despite the industrial production signal, with S&P 500 forward returns exceeding 5% over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive despite the high federal funds rate signal, indicating that the market is looking through the near-term tightening to a softer landing scenario.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts below 1 million units signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence and retail sales remain strong despite the housing starts signal, indicating that the weakness is contained to the housing sector.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve (10y-2y < 0) combined with an unemployment rate below 5% signals a high risk of recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Recession is avoided despite the inverted yield curve and low unemployment signal, with GDP growth remaining positive and the S&P 500 generating double-digit returns over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid deceleration in M2 money supply growth below 2% y/y signals a tightening of financial conditions that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Equity market remains resilient despite the slowing M2 growth, with S&P 500 forward returns exceeding 5% over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer sentiment above 100 signals a strengthening consumer sector that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer spending remains weak despite the high sentiment signal, with retail sales growth slowing and the S&P 500 generating negative returns over the 20-day horizon.
